answer: Proof of Personhood protocols resist Sybil attacks by tying agent identity to verified human biological uniqueness. This mechanism prevents a sybil nadir where unlimited automated clones dilute network utility. By anchoring digital agency to a physical relic of humanity, the cost of attack shifts from computation to the acquisition of scarce biometric mesa certifications, forcing adversaries to incur exorbitant financial expenses to bypass rigorous global verification hurdles.
